outcome.technical: plugins/audit/hooks/_config.py: new lift_house_bodies(cmd) -> (view, lifted), the one reader of which heredoc body inside a substitution is data. It walks lines with quoting carried across them, and lifts a body only when the substitution is the exact template: a double quote opening the argument at the command's own level, $( or a backquote, cat, a marker quoted with single, double or no quotes and nothing after it on its line, no <<- form, the terminator alone and exact on its line, then )" or backquote-quote first on the next line; an unquoted delimiter's body must hold no $( or backquote; and sink_carries(skeleton) must hold, where skeleton is the command with every heredoc body removed. split_heredocs calls it first; the pending sink verdict is gone, so _substitution_runs_body answers only shell or code. _HEREDOC_START gains a lookahead so a delimiter word with anything after its identifier (E-X, E'X', 'E'X) is no marker, and its lines stay text. .claude/hooks/guard-uncommitted.py: the second fallback reader (_runs_text, _keeps_quoted, _code, _literal, _heredoc_marker, _bodies and the runner tuples) is deleted; executed_text now returns the lift_house_bodies view, and reading() grades an untokenizable line by the shapes over that view. The executed reading was removed because it cannot happen any more: git_invocations already lifts through split_heredocs, so a lifted view parses exactly when the line does. Docstrings and comments were updated in _config, guard-history-rewrite, guard-uncommitted, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. CONTRIBUTING.md is outside this task's files; the plan gate allowed the edit with no refusal, and it was needed because its sentence described the deleted runner-list fallback. tools/prove-gates.py is unchanged: no row anchors in _config.py or guard-uncommitted.py.
